notes.title: To those waiting for Play Test access!
notes.content:
We have done testing with a small closed group and received invaluable fantastic constructive feedback. 

There were various issues such as 
[olist]
[*]freedom of movement
[*]lack of hand holding - While I want to trust and encourage critical thinking, I went too far haha
[*]a few small confusing 
[/olist]

Happy to hear that story & immersion were highly rated!

To those who are waiting in the Play Test for access, if you'd like to get earlier access, please hop onto our [url=https://discord.com/invite/eXnf7KktdP]Discord[/url] and let me know! 

P.S Steam Play Test doesn't let me choose so I'm prioritizing those I can directly speak to, connect with and further query feedback until I have a build I feel I can't push further!

notes.title: Thank You Alphas!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello friends!
[/h2]

Thank you for showing interest and signing up to the Alpha Program. We have nearly 100 interests in a short period which is crazy! Wishlists are close to 100! A small first milestone! 

This post is to let you know that we have a demo build and are internally testing it with a few closed testers before making it available to you all. 

While I believe there will be many bugs and improvements to be made from when you see, I'd like the first impression to be our best effort! 

[h3]For now, here's a Monster coming soon![/h3]
